<function=python>

def pink1(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B':
            pts=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)

start = pink1(current_frame)
seq=[start]
for k in range(12):
    action(['UP'])
    s = pink1(current_frame)
    seq.append(s)
    if s==start: break
print("cycle length:", len(seq)-1)
for i,s in enumerate(seq): print(i, ''.join(s))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
